title: SPEECH＆AUDIO PROC＆REC
description: Fundamentals of digital speech processing and audio signals. Acoustic and perceptual basics of audio. Short-time Fourier analysis. Analysis and filterbank models. Speech and audio coding, compression, and reconstruction. Acoustic feature extraction and classification. Recognition techniques for speech and other sounds, including hidden Markov models
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( ELEN E4810 ) or ELEN E4810 ; or instructor's permission.
